about.title:
Even small ideas
are worth seeing through.
about.first: I like useful tools and am curious about new ways to play. I plan, design, and develop apps I'd want to use and games I'd want to keep exploring.
about.second: I bring ideas to life with Flutter and Unity, refining the experience from a single tap to the flow between screens. This is where I collect the projects made along the way.

fillday.headline: Your own rhythm for filling the day.
fillday.description: A planner that brings schedules, tasks, and the day's feelings into one flow. Gather scattered records and quietly reflect on the day you've filled.
facet.headline: Familiar numbers, a new perspective.
facet.description: A puzzle game that looks at familiar numbers from a new perspective.
moonjunk.headline: With every repair, a story continues.
moonjunk.description: A mobile game about repairing forgotten objects and discovering the stories left in parcels. Join a little repairer and piece together the tales of a long night, one by one.
oseonro.headline: Music begins on the path you draw.
oseonro.description: A creative rhythm game where hand-drawn lines become paths and movement along them becomes sound. Draw, run, and draw again to create your own flow.
